tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rtsa gsum zab mo kun 'dus kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs padma'i do shal bzhugs/1$0000300 chos sku'i ston pa kun bzang snang mtha' yas// sku dang ye shes khyab bdag spyan ras gzigs// rtsa gsum dbyer med sprul sku padma 'byung*// thod phreng sde lngar shar la gsol ba 'debs// yi dam kun 'dus dbang chen rta mchog dpal// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug phag mo mkhar chen bza'// a tsar ye shes mchog dbyangs mnga' bdag rje// bai ro tsa na rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zab gter sgo 'byed kun bzang bde chen rgyal// padma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal// bstan 'dzin 'phel rgyas 'jam mgon gu ṇa'i zhabs// chos kyi nyi ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'gyur med tshe dbang rgya mtsho 'jam pa'i dbyangs// chos kyi blo gros dbang chen rta phag sku// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rab 'byams rtsa gsum lha// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// dbang gis rgyud smin dam tshig rnam par dag /snang srid lha dang bla ma'i rnam rol gyi// bskyed rdzogs lam gyis dngos grub 'dod dgu thob// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal thob shog /

ces lcags khyi rgyal zla ba'i tshes nyer lnga nyin lho 'brug sman ljongs nas rin chen gter mdzod dbang khrid 'don skabs rgyal khams pa maṅga las gsol ba btab pa rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /
